news.title: Walton Goggins doesn't know if Fallout will "come back for season 4" but is confident season 3 remains true to "the sacred nature of this game"
Not even Walton Goggins knows if Fallout will have a Season 4: 'if we get the opportunity to come back for season four, that would continue to honor how sacred this is to people'
Fallout Season 4 Gets Disappointing Update After Walton Goggins' Cryptic Goodbye
